lead.title: Yann LeCun announces new company AMI Labs for "the next revolution in AI"
lead.summary: The Turing Award winner and former Meta chief AI scientist says he is founding AMI Labs to pursue the next major wave of AI progress, and his bio now lists him as Founder and Chair. He framed the venture as a continuation of pursuing ideas others considered impossible.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA launches RTX Spark superchip: gaming PC, creative studio and personal AI supercomputer in one
top_stories.summary: The Arm-based superchip pairs up to 20 CPU cores with a Blackwell GPU carrying 6,144 CUDA cores and 128GB of LPDDR5X at up to 300 GB/s, aimed at agentic AI workloads on the desktop.

top_stories.title: Tenstorrent raises $1.5 billion Series E at $6.2 billion valuation
top_stories.summary: The RISC-V AI chip company's oversubscribed round brings total funding past $2.19 billion, with ARK Invest, Fidelity, Morgan Stanley and T. Rowe Price among the investors. Capital is earmarked for volume manufacturing of Galaxy systems and commercial expansion.

top_stories.title: Gemini agent formally verifies new Busy Beaver acceleration rules
top_stories.summary: A Google DeepMind agent autonomously picks Turing machines, spots patterns in execution traces, and proposes compact acceleration rules verified with Lean proofs — new confirmed rules for 11 previously unresolved machines. An early example of agents choosing their own problems on uncomputable territory.

top_stories.title: Together AI launches Post-Training: run your own SFT and RL pipelines, keep the weights
top_stories.summary: The new product gives users full control over data, rewards, environments and the training loop while Together handles the infrastructure, with LoRA or full fine-tuning, parallel experiments, and downloadable weights. Available now for open models from Meta, Qwen and Moonshot.

items.title: Halcyon: text-to-image generation without language pretraining
items.summary: Early-fusion multimodal models pretrained from scratch on 100M image-text pairs show language pretraining is not required for strong T2I generation; Halcyon-0.52B beats LlamaGen-XL/8.

items.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: synthesizing environments for computer-use agents
items.summary: WildAWM is a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments to train generalist computer-use agents, avoiding the security risks of learning directly on real systems.

items.title: Safety mid-training: internalizing LLM safety as a foundational capability
items.summary: Post-training safety degrades when later training omits safety data and often costs capability; the paper proposes inserting safety data as a mid-training phase instead of a post-hoc layer.

items.title: OpenVLHarness: visual agentic tool-use with multimodal memory
items.summary: Across 22 benchmarks, simply raising MLLM inference budget yields only modest gains on tasks needing grounded perception; coupling visual agents with tools and memory closes the gap.

items.title: ProteinGeoBench: structural-biology agents fluent at lookup, lost in geometry
items.summary: 131 protein-structure tasks and 4,249 rollouts show frontier agents retrieve structural metadata well but compute geometry from coordinates far less reliably.

items.title: Laminar (YC S24) launches RL-trained model that finds errors in agent traces
items.summary: A reinforcement-learning-trained model that automatically detects errors and failure points in AI agent traces, aimed at debugging production agent workflows.

items.title: Mac.apk runs Android apps natively on macOS
items.summary: The open-source project lets Android APK apps run on macOS and drew significant Hacker News attention within hours of release.

items.title: Cairn opens windows into AI-driven cyber operations
items.summary: Norforge released Cairn, giving security teams visibility into agent-based attacks as they investigate AI-driven intrusions.

items.title: Ailegal: a legal assistant that refuses to cite law it can't verify
items.summary: An AI legal assistant designed to only cite case law it can verify, targeting hallucination risk in legal research.

items.title: OpenSpline: realtime talking avatar running free locally at 90+ FPS
items.summary: An open-source realtime talking-avatar system that runs locally on consumer GPUs with no cloud service required.
